name: DaVinci Edit Page Keyframe Easing For Titles
use_when: A simple title, graphic, crop, opacity, or position move can be done in the Edit page inspector.
The motion does not require Fusion nodes, masks, or tracking.
The agent needs a quick title or object move that still lands smoothly.
avoid_when: The effect needs compositing, tracking, masks, or reusable node logic.
The graphic must interact with multiple layers in a complex way.
The rough cut is still changing so motion timing would churn.

timeline_pattern.speed_rule: Closer keyframes create faster moves; farther keyframes create calmer moves.
timeline_pattern.easing_rule: Ease the landing keyframe so the title resolves instead of stopping mechanically.
timeline_pattern.hold_rule: Add a hold after landing if the viewer needs to read text or inspect the target.

motion.rule: Animate only the property needed for the job, then check the curve and final hold.

keyframe_values.social_pop_window: Fast social title moves can start around 4-8 frames if readability holds.
keyframe_values.calmer_title_window: Calmer title moves often need 8-16 frames plus a readable hold.
keyframe_values.read_hold: Hold until the phrase or object is understood before clearing or cutting.

sound.rule: Add a small pop, hit, or whoosh only when the title entrance is an intended emphasis beat.

captions.rule: Title motion should not duplicate or cover captions unless it intentionally replaces them for that moment.

color.rule: Title color, shadow, stroke, or backing must remain readable over the graded footage.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use drawtext with x/y/alpha expressions and easing curves; render contact sheets around title entry and hold.
implementation.remotion: Use interpolated translate/opacity/scale values with easing and explicit hold frames.
implementation.blender: Animate text/object transform keyframes and set interpolation to eased curves.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use text keyframes or preset entrance animations, then manually review readability and collisions.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Essential Graphics or Effect Controls keyframes with Ease In/Ease Out and safe-area review.

common_mistakes: Opening Fusion for a basic title move that the Edit page can handle.
Leaving title motion linear or abrupt.
Animating text before checking line breaks and readability.
Letting the title land on top of captions, faces, UI, or proof.
qc: Does the title motion land smoothly and intentionally?
Is the phrase readable after the move?
Do title and captions avoid collision or unnecessary duplication?
Does the graphic clear before competing with the next beat?
Is a Fusion effect actually needed, or is Edit page keyframing sufficient?
